risks: Revenue concentration is increasingly U.S.-weighted and government exposure can amplify policy/geopolitical sensitivity.

contradictions: Explosive AI demand coexists with rising concern about third-party model data governance.
Rapid AI-driven adoption and sovereign-control positioning coexist with dependence on external model providers whose retention policies may conflict with sensitive-data requirements.
